Related defect observed in the same session: when an etude launch process is killed (SIGTERM) while in state='admitting' before writing a session or run, database.py:469 permanently blocks all future launch/queue attempts for that run with 'reconciling existing request <id>' because nothing ever transitions an abandoned admitting launch with no sessions to failed.
